description: Polymer Diels-Alder cross-linking initial conditions. State variables x0-x3 sampled independently from uniform distributions. System: four-variable reversible chemical reaction network with monotonic convergence to equilibrium.

x0.description: Diene component concentration — starts high (up to 30), consumed through bimolecular reactions

x1.description: Dienophile component concentration — starts near zero, transiently rises via bimolecular feedback

x2.description: Cross-linked adduct concentration — starts near zero, accumulates as x0*x1 reaction proceeds

x3.description: De-cross-linked component concentration — starts at moderate level (0.5-10), consumed by x0

simulation_params.description: 100 intervals of dt=0.5 over t=[0,50], matching the synthetic data generator

notes: ICs sampled independently from uniform distributions matching the synthetic data generator: x0~U(1,30), x1~U(0,0.1), x2~U(0,0.1), x3~U(0.5,10). Fixed parameters: k1=0.03, k2=0.01, k3=0.08, k4=0.03.
